arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Richard Taranto argued Verizon should not face antitrust liability.
He stated the Telecommunications Act creates a comprehensive regime.
He claimed the Act forces lawful monopolies to compete.
He argued the Sherman Act protects independently developed competition only.
